meta.title: Services | Maneda Design Studios
meta.description: Residential design, interior design, site analysis, design consultations, and construction documents for homes and additions in Central Florida.

hero.label: Services
hero.title: Design first. Drawings follow.
hero.intro: Five services, listed in the order a project uses them. Residential design leads. Construction documents come last, as the next step for design clients.

residential-design.what: A designer works with you from the first sketch to a resolved design. You get concept options, plan and massing studies, 3D views, and a clear explanation of why each decision was made. The project is designed for your lot, your program, and Florida code.
included: Revisions as defined in the agreement
notIncluded: Structural, mechanical, electrical, or plumbing engineering
residential-design.suits: Owners building or changing a home in Central Florida who want design judgment, not only drawings.

interior-design.what: Layout, finishes, lighting intent, and material direction, resolved together with the building. Interiors are designed as part of the plan, so rooms, light, and materials work together.
interior-design.suits: Owners of new homes, renovations, and additions who want interiors resolved with the building, not added after it.

site-analysis.what: A written report on a lot before you buy it or design on it. It sets out what zoning, setbacks, flood zone, and access allow, and what the lot can hold. It is a design-level review of public records. It is not a survey, a legal opinion, or an engineering study.
included: Setbacks, height, and lot coverage limits
Easements and access, from available records
A short program fit: what the lot can hold
site-analysis.suits: Buyers comparing lots, owners planning an addition, and builders testing a site before committing.
site-analysis.pricingNote: [PLACEHOLDER: what moves a site report above the starting price]

consultations.what: A working conversation with a designer about your lot, your program, and your options. You leave with a clear direction and the next steps. Choose virtual or in person.
included: Review of your site, plans, or photos before the call
Overview of the code and permit path
notIncluded: Site visits beyond the booked session
deliverables: A summary of direction and next steps
consultations.suits: Owners deciding whether and how to start, and owners with a design that needs a second opinion.

construction-documents.what: The next step after design. Once the design is approved, it is developed into a set of construction documents, so the design that was approved is the design that gets built. This service is offered to design clients.
included: Construction document set developed from the approved design
Coordination with your builder and engineers
notIncluded: Structural, mechanical, electrical, or plumbing engineering
construction-documents.suits: Design clients whose approved design is ready to be priced, permitted, and built.

meta.title: Process | Maneda Design Studios
meta.description: How a residential design project works with MDS, from inquiry to construction documents, with what happens, what you provide, and what you get.

hero.label: Process
hero.title: How a project works.
hero.intro: Six phases, in plain language. Most of the value sits in phases four and five, where the design is decided.

phases.title: Inquiry and scope
phases.happens: You send the inquiry form. We review it and reply, and we talk through the project, the lot, and the budget range.
phases.provide: Project description, site location, target start, and files or photos if you have them.
phases.get: A clear read on fit, and the next step.

phases.title: Proposal and agreement
phases.happens: We send a written proposal with scope, deliverables, and fee. You review it and sign the agreement.
phases.provide: Questions, decisions, and the signed agreement.
phases.get: A written scope, a deliverables list, and a fee.

phases.title: Site and code review
phases.happens: We review the lot, zoning, setbacks, flood zone, and the jurisdiction's rules. Constraints are found before they shape the design.
phases.provide: Survey, plat, or deed if you have them. Site access if a visit is needed.
phases.get: A constraints summary that frames the design.

phases.title: Concept and schematic design
phases.happens: We test massing and plan options with sketches and 3D views. Each option shows how the house sits, how light enters, and how the rooms connect. You choose a direction.
phases.provide: Feedback on the options. Your priorities for rooms, light, and budget.
phases.get: Concept sketches, massing and plan studies, 3D views, and a schematic design set.

phases.title: Design development and revisions
phases.happens: The chosen design is resolved: room sizes, openings, materials, and finishes. Revisions are made in the rounds defined in the agreement.
phases.provide: Decisions on materials and finishes, and timely feedback.
phases.get: A design development set and material and finish direction.

phases.title: Construction documents and permit support
phases.happens: For design clients, the approved design is developed into construction documents and coordinated for permit submittal. The set goes to your builder as the basis for pricing and construction.
phases.provide: Your builder and engineers, if you have them. Responses to permit review comments.
phases.get: A construction document set and support through permit review comments.

meta.title: About | Maneda Design Studios
meta.description: Manolo Castaneda is an architectural designer with 10+ years in multifamily and retail projects, based in Central Florida and bilingual in English and Portuguese.

hero.label: About
hero.title: Manolo Castaneda
hero.portraitNote: Portrait: Manolo, in an architectural setting

story: Manolo Castaneda is an architectural designer with more than 10 years of experience in multifamily and retail projects. He trained in architecture in Brazil and the United States, with degrees from the Catholic University of Brasilia and NJIT. He is bilingual in English and Brazilian Portuguese and works from Central Florida.

He designs from the site and from how people live in a building: space, light, circulation, and how a room is used. A design is not finished until it can be permitted and built, so Florida code and jurisdiction rules are part of the process from the first sketch. Code literacy is what lets a design get built. It is part of the work, not a separate service.

meta.title: Privacy policy | Maneda Design Studios
meta.description: What information Maneda Design Studios collects through this website and how it is used.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you send an inquiry, we receive what you type in the form: name, email, optional phone, project details, and any file link you share. We use it only to reply to you and to scope your project.

sections.title: How the form works
sections.text: The form is processed by a third-party form service, which delivers your message to the studio email. We do not sell or share your information.

sections.title: Cookies and storage
sections.text: This site does not set tracking cookies. It stores your language choice in your browser so the site opens in your language on your next visit. You can clear it in your browser settings.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: This site does not currently use analytics. If a privacy-friendly analytics tool is added, this page will be updated first.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: To ask about or remove information you sent us, email the studio.
